listings_price_shape.name: listings_price_shape
listings_price_shape.value:
("listings"."price_mode" = 'ON_REQUEST'
            AND "listings"."price_amount_minor" IS NULL AND "listings"."price_currency" IS NULL
            AND "listings"."price_period" IS NULL AND NOT "listings"."price_negotiable")
          OR ("listings"."price_mode" = 'FIXED'
            AND "listings"."price_amount_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "listings"."price_amount_minor" > 0
            AND "listings"."price_currency" IS NOT NULL)

listings_published_has_slug.name: listings_published_has_slug
listings_published_has_slug.value: "listings"."status" NOT IN ('PUBLISHED', 'SOLD', 'RENTED', 'ARCHIVED') OR ("listings"."slug" IS NOT NULL AND "listings"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)
